scope: Prevent the concrete BLOCK adapter from treating an entity with public eType INSERT as a DRW_Insert without confirming its runtime type.

behavior: INSERT serialization requires a DRW_Insert runtime object, the exact runtime type, and the matching public eType.
A mismatched object is refused through the adapter's fail-closed entity path before the writer reads INSERT-only members.
Correcting the public type tag permits a same-adapter retry.

validationProfile.source: A locally constructed DRW_Point captured through dx_iface; the test mutates only its public eType. No DWG/DXF fixture is used or committed.
assertions: The mismatched INSERT attempt is refused atomically and preserves a pre-existing destination.
The same adapter retries after restoring DRW::POINT and re-imports one POINT with its source coordinates intact.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; ASCII/Binary refusal, destination preservation, same-adapter retry, and POINT readback.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture was added or committed.

limitations: This validates adapter runtime-type safety and generated POINT transport only; it does not qualify INSERT body semantics, BLOCK graph closure, physical producer coverage, or native consumer behavior.
No support claim is promoted; P8 remains open.
